messages:
Maya Patel: Quick heads-up — we have PR #7894 (migration guide for v2 -> v3 snippets) that needs to land before the docs cutoff on Thursday EOD. Feature-flag for the new routing is scheduled to open Tue morning. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7894

Jon Rivera: Who are the reviewers on that? I can take a quick pass but want the SME to look at the runtime details.

Alex Chen: @Jon Rivera I started an initial review — main thing is the code examples for batching need to reflect the new SDK call shape (`client.generate({batching: {max_tokens}})`). I can finish tomorrow morning.

Priya Singh: CI preview failing on linkcheck:
```
CI: linkcheck: broken link https://old.example.com/sdk/batching -> 404
```
I pushed a suggested fix to the anchor and added a redirect note in the draft.

Maya Patel: Thanks @Priya, can you paste the two-line fix here? I can do a micro-commit.

Priya Singh: Sure — replace the anchor at the bottom of batching.md with:
```
- See SDK batching (v3): /sdk/v3/batching.md#overview
+ See SDK batching (v3): /sdk/v3/batching.md#continuous-batching
```
Also added a note: "Old anchors redirect to new v3 docs; contact @docs if you hit a 404."

CI Bot: preview build failed for branch feature/docs-7894 — error: broken link(s) detected. Full log: https://ci.redwood/preview/7894/logs

Alex Chen: After Priya's commit, CI looks green locally. Once preview passes we should request final signoff from @Sam Torres for migrations and @Maya Patel for editorial.

Sam Torres: I can sign off on migration correctness by noon Wed. Quick question — are we keeping the v2 examples as-is or replacing with v3 plus a short v2 compatibility note?

Maya Patel: Plan is to show v3 examples as primary, keep v2 in a small "compatibility" section at the end (1–2 snippets). That prevents confusing new users but keeps migration help for existing customers.

Jon Rivera: For merge timing: cutoff is Thu EOD for this minor release. If preview passes by Wed afternoon we can merge Thu morning into the doc-release branch. Otherwise we queue for next patch. Recommend merging Thu 09:00 PST to give QA time.

Alex Chen: Agree. I'll tag reviewers now and unblock the CI fix.

Priya Singh: Pushed the anchor fix and updated the v2 compatibility snippet to use the `legacyClient.migrate()` call.

Docs Bot: Preview build started for PR #7894 — URL: https://preview.redwood/docs/7894

CI Bot: Preview build succeeded — all checks passed.

Maya Patel: Great — @Sam Torres can you review and mark as approved when ready? If Sam approves I'll merge Thu 09:00 PST unless someone asks to hold. :thumbsup:

Sam Torres: Reviewing now. Small nit: change `legacyClient.migrate()` example to show returns vs promise form. I'll push a 1-line nit fix.

Jon Rivera: If the nit is a tiny change, we can merge after Sam's approve and re-run preview. No need to wait for additional round.

Sam Torres: Approved and pushed the nit fix.

Alex Chen: Re-ran preview, green.

Maya Patel: Merging Thu 09:00 PST as planned. I'll add a note to the release tracker and set the PR to "merge-queue/priority: high".

Jon Rivera: Thanks everyone. If feature flag slips past Tue, we should switch PR to post-release patch.

Maya Patel: Noted — will monitor FF rollout and update this thread.

Docs Bot: PR #7894 merged into doc-release at 09:03 PST Thu — changelog entry created.

Maya Patel: Closing thread — thanks all for the quick turn. :tada:
